clues.it: Marta era accanto a un droide.
Irene era l'unica seduta su una sedia.
clues.en: Irene was the only one sitting on a chair.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a un serbatoio.
clues.en: Luca was beside a fuel tank.

clues.it: Dario era sul Ponte di Comando.
clues.en: Dario was on the Command Deck.
Ugo was alone in the Hangar.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

steps.it: L'indizio di Marta lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Marta's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 7th.

steps.it: Fabio può stare solo nella 4ª riga: escludendola, a Irene resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Fabio can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Irene a single square: row 2nd, column 1st.

steps.it: Giada può stare solo nella 4ª colonna.
steps.en: Giada can only be in the 4th column.
